Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
I will soon send material for the other pages. I have a queer little drama half written, and one or two other things that only require to be got into shape[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: This was extra material to make up the collection of previously published stories which appeared as [Bye-Words](../books.html#135) (1879).

The \'queer little drama\' was \'The Campbells are Coming\'.
